conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: "Jumping the shark" refers to the moment a TV show or series passes its peak and begins a decline in quality, often by introducing absurd or unbelievable plotlines. It comes from an episode of "Happy Days" where Fonzie literally jumps over a shark on water skis.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
